name: iceni-library-manager
description: Spicetify custom app: a dashboard for auditing and maintaining the Spotify library

scripts.test: npm run --silent test:unit && npm run --silent test:render
scripts.test:unit: esbuild src/api/scan.ts src/api/export.ts src/api/cache.ts src/api/playcounts.ts src/ui/columns.tsx src/ui/facets.tsx src/ui/dismiss.ts src/ui/columnOrder.ts src/ui/marqueeStart.ts src/ui/gridWidth.ts src/ui/playlistFilter.ts src/ui/playContext.ts src/ui/filterState.ts src/ui/removed.tsx src/ui/format.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outdir=dist-test --outbase=src --out-extension:.js=.mjs --jsx=transform --jsx-factory=Spicetify.React.createElement --jsx-fragment=Spicetify.React.Fragment --log-level=warning && node test/analysis.test.mjs
